name: GRouNdGAN causal graph pickle
description: Pickled GRouNdGAN causal graph dictionary. Keys are target gene indices and values are sets of regulator/TF gene indices in the reference AnnData var_names order.
validation_notes: The file must unpickle to a dictionary compatible with GRouNdGAN CausalGANFactory.
Dictionary keys and values must be zero-based integer indices into groundgan_reference_h5ad.var_names.
The graph must be directed, acyclic and bipartite in the sense required by GRouNdGAN: regulators cannot also be regulated target genes.
The pickle stores topology only; activation/repression sign is not represented natively.
